summary: Release validation pass for Santa Cruz Strength V2. Backend v2 smoke suite: 9 passed, 1 skipped (no /auth/me), 0 failed. Verified 27 blog articles seeded via GET /api/blog (total=27); blog detail endpoint GET /api/blog/post/{slug} returns full content (e.g., 2679 chars for why-surfers-in-santa-cruz-should-lift-weights). All public pages render successfully at desktop and mobile (390px): /, /join, /personal-training, /contact, /about, /blog, /blog/:slug, /events, /pride, /local-wellness, /privacy, /terms. Blog listing shows 26 unique post links (matches paginated 20+featured layout; total 27 confirmed via API). Navbar shows THE GYM, COACHING, MEMBERSHIP, ABOUT, BLOG. Footer includes address (151 Harvey West Blvd Ste D, Santa Cruz, CA 95060) and phone (408 337-6709). Staff login with management@santacruzstrength.com / ***REDACTED*** authenticates directly and redirects to /staff/dashboard (1408 leads, all 4 stat cards populated: NEW 7 DAYS=4, TOUR BOOKED=4, MEMBERS=3, TOTAL LEADS=1408). Kanban board renders with New Leads (195), Contacted (1), Tour/Trial (2), Member (2), Closed. All staff nav routes load without errors: /staff/blog, /staff/events (event 'Open Gym Night' visible), /staff/campaigns (Iron Roses Re-engagement 2026 shown), /staff/team (Mike, Teresa, Brit), /staff/content, /staff/corporate (Verve Coffee lead visible). Mobile responsive verified on / and /join.
passed_tests: Homepage + /join render correctly at 390px mobile viewport
Blog listing renders 26+ unique post links
Staff login -> /staff/dashboard with Kanban board and 4 stat cards
All 6 staff nav routes load: blog, events, campaigns, team, content, corporate
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5313 lines - still exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into per-resource routers (auth, leads, staff, content, team, blog, campaigns, corporate) before further growth
Blog detail endpoint uses /api/blog/post/{slug} while listing uses /api/blog - slightly asymmetric; consider /api/blog/{slug} for REST consistency (no impact on functionality)

Two known test-suite env contamination failures pre-noted by main agent (previewSafety.test.js frontend, and 5 write_gate_http backend tests expecting ALLOW_DATABASE_WRITES=false) - not code bugs but should be gated via env-aware skips to keep CI green
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed lead created via test_public_lead_creation_v1 in v2 smoke suite; no cleanup implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Release validation confirmed green. All 27 blog articles seeded and rendering. Staff login is direct (no OTP). /staff/campaigns, /staff/team, /staff/events, /staff/corporate render compact single-column layouts (short body text lengths are expected, not bugs). Blog detail API path is /api/blog/post/{slug} (not /api/blog/{slug}). Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env; backend has ALLOW_DATABASE_WRITES=true and ALLOW_SEEDING=true for preview.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found in release validation pass.
